subject: The confession that changed everything for my dog
preview_text: I almost made the same mistake with my dog that 90% of owners make. Here's the truth I discovered.
body_paragraphs: Let me tell you about Bailey. A golden retriever who couldn't chase a ball for more than two minutes without panting like he'd run a marathon. I thought he was just getting older. I was wrong.

The vet said 'borderline obese' and I felt that punch in the gut. The guilt of every extra treat, every 'he looks hungry' moment. But here's what changed: I stopped guessing. I tracked one single week of his actual intake versus what he actually needed. The gap was terrifying. That's when PupShape clicked.

The calorie calculator isn't just numbers. It's the difference between guessing and knowing. It showed me exactly where those hidden calories were hiding - the training treats, the table scraps disguised as 'just a bite.' Within two weeks, Bailey was trotting after that ball again.

Open the app right now and tap 'Calorie Calculator.' Put in what you fed your dog yesterday. Just one day. The truth might surprise you. P.S. The 110+ success stories all started with this one click. They all had that 'oh' moment too.
